title: A Aa
desc: Anasuya is the daughter of Mahalakshmi, a rich and strict businesswoman. Her life takes a turn for the better when her father sends her to a village to visit her aunt.

title: We Are Gangers
desc: An undercover cop navigates a high-stakes scam while teaming up with an unlikely partner, leading to chaotic and thrilling situations.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mother's wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

title: Anaconda
desc: A snake hunter offers his assistance to a documentary crew attempting to film an indigenous tribe in the Amazon. But as the journey progresses, his presence forces them to veer into dangerous waters.

title: Maari
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: A desperate smuggler finds himself strapped for cash. Later, when an agent offers him a fortune to extradite a notorious drug lord from Malaysia, he accepts only to face a world of betrayal.

title: Bagheera
desc: A psycho killer creates an application to kill women who get a complaint about cheating on their man. However, his life changes when he meets a psychology student.
